reading.title: Four-day school weeks
reading.text: In parts of the United States, some rural schools have moved to a four-day week. The change was intended to save money on transport and heating, and to help schools attract teachers. School days are extended by about an hour to make up for the lost time. Early studies suggest that attendance has improved slightly, but test scores in maths tend to fall. There is also tension between families: working parents must find childcare on the fifth day, while others enjoy the extra time together.

items.s: The four-day week was introduced mainly in big cities.
School days are longer under the new system.
Maths results usually improve under the four-day week.
